title: Who Mexico was: his real name and the Veterans Hospital
summary: Neither knows Mexico's real name; Willard met him in a Los Angeles Veterans Hospital where Duke arranged for him to go out on pass and had her taking down his life story.

story.theme_name: Illness, injury and the deaths of colleagues
story.community_name: Illness, injury and death among jazz musicians

blocks.x: Do you know Mexico's real name?
He came here, you know. He lived here for a while.

I know. He was in the Veterans Hospital here when I met him, although I didn't know -- When I met him I didn't know who he was. I just knew that there was somebody named Mexico in the fifties. When Duke would come

-- he would sign him out or get him signed out of the Veterans Hospital. I don't know whether he had TB or what but he had some affliction and was living in the hospital. But he would come out on a pass when Duke would come to town. And Duke was taking his life -- in fact, he had me working with him taking down his life story. I don't know whatever happened to the life story.
And later, after I didn't see Mexico anymore, I found out who Mexico was, and the only name I ever heard was just Mexico.
Uh-huh. That's all I knew, Mexico.
He was Mexican and Indian, I think, wasn't he?
I guess they're all mixed up.
And he said he grew up in a carnival. I remember him saying that, --
-- traveling on the road as a child.
